2608.23172.title: CaRGo-T: Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought improves Multimodal Humor Comprehension
2608.23172.paper_summary: Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable versatility across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, understanding humor remains challenging because humorous content often depends on subtle interactions among entities, events, context, and implicit relationships across image and text modalities. These interactions can involve complex chains of reasoning that are difficult to capture through conventional prompting or linear chain-of-thought reasoning. In this work, we propose CaRGo-T (Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought), a reasoning framework that represents the causal and contextual relationships underlying multimodal humor as a lightweight graph-based reasoning structure. The graph is serialized into a code-based representation generated by a VLM, which can subsequently be interpreted by the same or a different VLM to produce the final prediction in zero-shot or in-context learning settings. We evaluate CaRGo-T on humor understanding and humor detection across four datasets spanning diverse forms of comedic content, including satire, sarcasm, and memes. Experiments with state-of-the-art commercial and open-source VLMs show that CaRGo-T consistently improves performance over existing reasoning-based baselines, achieving gains of approximately 1-20% on humor understanding and 1-3% on humor detection. Further analysis using mutual information indicates that the reasoning representations produced by CaRGo-T contain more information relevant to the target output than those generated by baseline reasoning approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/abhi1nandy2/CaRGo-T.
2608.23172.paper_summary_zh: 大型視覺-語言模型（VLMs）在各種多模態任務中展現了顯著的多樣性。<lb/>然而，理解幽默仍然具有挑戰性，因為幽默內容通常依賴於實體、事件、上下文和圖像與文本模態之間的隱含關係的微妙互動。<lb/>這些互動可能涉及複雜的推理鏈，這些推理鏈難以通過傳統的提示或線性思考推理來捕捉。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們提出了CaRGo-T（因果推理思維圖），這是一種推理框架，將多模態幽默背後的因果和上下文關係表示為輕量級的圖形推理結構。<lb/>該圖形被序列化為由VLM生成的基於代碼的表示，隨後可以由相同或不同的VLM解釋，以在零-shot或上下文學習環境中生成最終預測。<lb/>我們在四個數據集上評估了CaRGo-T的幽默理解和幽默檢測，這些數據集涵蓋了各種形式的喜劇內容，包括諷刺、挖苦和迷因。<lb/>與最先進的商業和開源VLM進行的實驗顯示，CaRGo-T在現有的基於推理的基準上持續提高了性能，在幽默理解上獲得了約1-20%的提升，在幽默檢測上獲得了1-3%的提升。<lb/>進一步的互信息分析表明，CaRGo-T產生的推理表示包含了比基準推理方法生成的更相關於目標輸出的信息。<lb/>代碼可在 https://github.com/abhi1nandy2/CaRGo-T 獲得。
